_comment: unity-dev — SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for path -> codemap shard. SKILL.md, build_codemap.py and build_index.py all read this file; none of them carries its own copy of the mapping. First matching pattern wins, so order matters: Editor before specific shards, catch-all last. Patterns are gitignore-style globs relative to the project root: ** crosses directories, * stays inside one segment.

shards.name: fruitmerge
shards.note: vendored Fruit Merge minigame, imported as-is. FIRST on purpose: its own Scripts/UI and Editor folders would otherwise be swallowed by the ui and editor shards below and mix vendor code into the host's maps

shards.name: editor
shards.note: editor-only tools; never in a build

shards.name: ui
shards.note: captions, PTT button, text input, HUD, ad-stub panel

shards.name: voice
shards.note: Gemini Live WebSocket transport, mic capture, playback, tool-call dispatch

shards.name: session
shards.note: flow state machine, states, break planning

shards.name: presentation
shards.note: character reactions, camera rig, ad stub

shards.name: persistence
shards.note: profile schema, local JSON repository, summarization

shards.name: core
shards.note: catch-all: Config, Bootstrap composition root, shared services
